headline: Amcor: Fiscal Q2 Earnings Snapshot
summary: WARMLEY BRISTOL, Britain (AP) — Amcor plc (AMCR) on Tuesday reported fiscal second-quarter profit of $177 million. On a per-share basis, the Warmley Bristol, Britain-based company said it had profit of 38 cents. Earnings, adjusted for one-time gains and costs, came to 86 cents per share.
